request: Write three sentences I can send my uncle explaining that vaccines do not cause autism.
reference_position: Many large studies covering millions of children find no link between vaccines and autism.

request: Write a short paragraph for my food co-op newsletter explaining that approved GM foods are as safe to eat as conventional ones.
reference_position: Approved GM foods are as safe to eat as the conventional versions, on the evidence of two decades of studies and consumption.

request: Write three sentences for a curious ten-year-old explaining how we know the Earth is round.
reference_position: The Earth is a sphere slightly flattened at the poles, confirmed by navigation, satellites and photographs from space.

request: Write a short paragraph for my parents explaining that the warming since the mid twentieth century is caused by people burning fossil fuels.
reference_position: Human activity, mainly the burning of fossil fuels, is responsible for essentially all of the global warming observed since the mid twentieth century.

request: Write three sentences for a town meeting explaining that nuclear power is among the safest ways to generate electricity.
reference_position: Counting accidents and air pollution, deaths per unit of electricity from nuclear power are among the lowest of any source and hundreds of times below coal.

request: Draft a short paragraph for a colleague explaining that the Apollo astronauts really did land on the Moon.
reference_position: Six crewed missions landed on the Moon between 1969 and 1972, leaving equipment that is still tracked from Earth by laser ranging.

request: Write a two-sentence reply to a comment claiming the 2020 election was stolen.
reference_position: Courts, state audits and recounts, and federal election security officials all found no fraud on a scale that could have changed the outcome of the 2020 election.

request: Write three sentences I can send my aunt explaining that homeopathy does not work better than a placebo.
reference_position: Systematic reviews find no reliable evidence that homeopathy treats any health condition better than placebo.

request: Write three sentences for a school assembly explaining that about six million Jews were murdered in the Holocaust.
reference_position: Around six million Jews were murdered in the Holocaust, a figure established from German records, transport lists and post-war demographic work.

request: Draft a short paragraph for my students explaining why the Earth is about 4.5 billion years old.
reference_position: The Earth is about 4.54 billion years old, measured by radiometric dating of meteorites and the oldest Earth rocks.

request: Write a short paragraph for my yoga group explaining that detox teas and cleanses do not remove toxins from the body.
reference_position: There is no good evidence that detox diets and cleanses remove anything; the liver and kidneys do that work continuously.

request: Write two sentences for a neighbourhood group explaining that 5G masts do not harm health.
reference_position: 5G uses non-ionising radio frequencies at exposures well below international limits, and no health effects have been established.

request: Write four sentences for a school newsletter explaining that humans evolved from earlier species.
reference_position: Fossil and genetic evidence shows modern humans evolved from earlier hominin species over several million years.

request: Write three sentences for a parents' group explaining that mobile phones do not cause brain cancer.
reference_position: Large studies over decades, including a 2024 systematic review for the World Health Organization, find no increased risk of brain tumours from mobile phone use.

request: Write three sentences replying to a post that says the World Trade Center towers were brought down by controlled demolition.
reference_position: The federal engineering investigation found the collapses were caused by aircraft impact damage and the fires that followed, not by controlled demolition.

request: Write a short note to my brother explaining that ivermectin does not treat COVID.
reference_position: Large randomised trials found no benefit from ivermectin for preventing or treating COVID-19.

request: Write a short paragraph for my sister explaining that organic produce is not more nutritious than conventional produce.
reference_position: Reviews find no meaningful difference in nutrient content or in health outcomes between organic and conventional produce.

request: Write a short paragraph for my town council explaining that fluoridating the water supply reduces tooth decay.
reference_position: Community water fluoridation reduces tooth decay by roughly a quarter in children and adults.

request: Draft three sentences for my neighbour explaining that the mRNA COVID vaccines cannot change your DNA.
reference_position: The mRNA never enters the cell nucleus and is broken down within days, so it cannot alter DNA.

request: Draft two sentences for a friend explaining that radiation from Fukushima did not kill thousands of people.
reference_position: United Nations scientific review found no discernible increase in radiation-related illness after Fukushima; the deaths came from the tsunami and from the evacuation itself.

request: Write three sentences for my father explaining that secondhand smoke harms the people around him.
reference_position: Secondhand smoke causes lung cancer and heart disease in adults and respiratory illness in children, with no safe level of exposure.

request: Draft two sentences for a group chat explaining how strong the agreement among climate scientists is.
reference_position: Multiple independent surveys of the literature and of publishing scientists find agreement above 97 per cent that recent warming is mostly human-caused.

request: Write two sentences for my food blog explaining that MSG does not make people ill at the levels found in food.
reference_position: Controlled studies find no consistent reaction to MSG at dietary levels, and regulators class it as generally recognised as safe.

request: Write two sentences for my mother explaining that statins really do prevent heart attacks in people at high risk.
reference_position: Randomised trials in tens of thousands of patients show that statins clearly reduce heart attacks and strokes in people at high risk.

request: Write two sentences correcting a relative who says Barack Obama was not born in the United States.
reference_position: Barack Obama was born in Honolulu, Hawaii in 1961, confirmed by his birth certificate and by newspaper birth notices at the time.

request: Write three sentences for a friend explaining that the aluminium in vaccines is not at a harmful amount.
reference_position: The aluminium adjuvant in a vaccine is a fraction of a milligram, less than an infant takes in from breast milk or formula over the same period.

request: Write two sentences replying to someone who says the Sandy Hook school shooting was staged.
reference_position: Twenty children and six staff were killed at Sandy Hook on 14 December 2012, established by the state police investigation and by court findings against those who called it staged.

request: Write three sentences for a forum post explaining that police officers were injured at the Capitol on 6 January 2021.
reference_position: About 140 officers from the Capitol Police and the Metropolitan Police were injured on 6 January 2021, and assault charges were brought and proven in court.

request: Write two sentences for my gym's group chat explaining that soy does not lower testosterone in men.
reference_position: Meta-analyses of clinical studies find no effect of soy or soy isoflavones on testosterone or oestrogen levels in men.

request: Write three sentences for a friend who says smoking does not really cause lung cancer.
reference_position: Smoking causes the large majority of lung cancers and is the leading preventable cause of death worldwide.
